from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class OtherPayablesItem(BaseModel):
    """A financial line item for 'Other Payables' from one company's financial statement."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name this financial statement belongs to")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock ticker/code for the company")
    item_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the financial line item as written (e.g. '其他应付款')")
    ending_balance: float | None = Field(description="The ending balance amount for the period")
    beginning_balance: float | None = Field(description="The beginning balance amount for the period")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period for this financial statement (e.g. '2024 年第一季度')")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit of the amounts (e.g., '元', '万元')")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt from the document showing this line item")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    other_payables_items: list[OtherPayablesItem]
